questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.stem: Translator's note 60 asks what efficiency condition applies to public goods. Explain.

answer.exemplar: Efficiency requires the sum of all consumers' marginal benefits to equal the marginal cost of providing the public good.

questions.explanation: Applying the efficient public provision rule — Summed benefit equals cost — yields "Efficiency requires the sum of all consumers' marginal benefits to equal the marginal cost of providing the public good". Reversing the reasoning would recover the given quantities.
